question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which storyline did you like best?
What's your favorite type of music?

nodes.text: Hector flips through the black notebook.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's see here... 'Found: One little black thingamajig.' Claimed by...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no. Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My MusicBoxx was claimed... By Zach!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's so bad about Zach? I know where he lives! We can go pick it up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, you don't understand! I didn't invite Zach to my party! He's gonna be so ticked off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Zach's not that bad... Why didn't you invite him?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That guy's been a real jerk lately... I bet he's mad at me because I made out with his girlfriend when we were on the Euro Trip!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen up, Hector. We came all the way out here, and we're already missing the party. Now, Zach only lives, like, fifteen minutes away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know you don't want to deal with him... But it's our only chance of getting your MusicBoxx back! And without the MusicBoxx...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No freaky dancing. All right, all right. Let's get moving.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen here, buddy. You gave away a student's property without even bothering to check ID!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a clear violation of Mall Security Protocol, and you know it!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well I... I mean... I...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now, the way I see it, you've got two choices. You can give us the list right now, and I might just forget about this breach of protocol...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or I can call up your manager, and you'll be out a gun and a badge faster than you can say 'habeas corpus'!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: No! No, there's, uh, there's no reason for that at all! Here's the record book, right here!
Monte hands Howard a thin black notebook.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good. Now, get back behind that desk and start doing your job... While you've still got one!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
Hector and Howard walk out of the office...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, that was amazing! How did you do that?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I once spent an entire summer just watching reruns of `Rules and Justice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I once spent an entire summer just watching reruns of [color=#e23b3b][i]Rules and Justice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Tell me, Officer Monte... How interested would you be in a little money on the side?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Son, are you trying to bribe me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... Technically?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: An officer of the law never accepts a bribe! Not money! Not favors! Not love!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Who offered you love?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A woman... Long, long ago...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And she was a heck of a lot better looking than a snot-nosed punk like you!
Monte dives across the room and tackles Howard to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Owww!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: How dare you sully this fine office?! How dare you undermine my authority?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why? Why? Why is this happening?!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And don't even think about setting foot in this mall, you hear?! You're banned for life!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry I messed that up, man...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You were great! While you were fighting with Officer Moustache, I snatched the record book!
Spike looks around nervously as he thinks...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Because there's going to be a live band later tonight!
The crowd explodes into wild cheers and applause!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Is there really going to be a live band later?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heck no! But that should keep them happy 'til Hector and Howard get back!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But what will we do then?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Then? Then it's their problem!
Meanwhile, outside...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's wrong, Linda? You look sad...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, it's nothing. It's just... I didn't realize there was going to be a live band...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You don't like live bands?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's not that... Earlier this week, Howard was asking me what my favorite song was, and I kind of thought he was going to get Hector to play it...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, I mean, I'm sure we can get the band to play it...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You think the band would play 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady' by `Smoothanasia?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You think the band would play 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady' by [color=#3b78e2][i]Smoothanasia?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: `That's` your favorite song?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That's[/i][/color] your favorite song?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, no offense, but I'm guessing the band will probably be a lot more hip than that. That song is, like, 25 years old!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know, but... It's just so sweet and romantic... It makes me smile every time I hear it!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, uh, I guess it's not the worst song out there...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess not...
Meanwhile, in the mall security office...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Excuse me, sir? We were hoping to see the Lost and Found!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If it isn't Bonnie and Clyde.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hope I'm Clyde...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What can I help you two miscreants with?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, you see, we're looking for a missing MusicBoxx...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A MusicBoxx? What in blue blazes is a MusicBoxx?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a little black gadget... It stores and plays music...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You mean the thingamajig? Why didn't you say so in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah, I found one today by the food court... But some kid came by and claimed it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You just gave it away?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You didn't check ID or anything?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Eh, all you young punks look the same to me anyway, with your baggy jeans and your spiky hair and your hula hoops...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You want to stand out in a crowd, son? Grow a moustache! A strong, virile moustache! That's how you tell a man from a boy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, sir, there's got to be some kind of record you keep for things like this...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yeah, we've got a record all right. Of course, we've got a record.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But why the heck would I ever show it to a pair of smooth-faced punks like you two?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Um... Okay...
Brendan steps forward to address the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, attention... Everyone... There's, uh, been some complications...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Put on some music!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, see, that's the thing... Howard and Hector, they, uh...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Come on! What are you waiting for?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's that... Uh... Well...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, put on some music, or you're getting a beatdown!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aiiiiiiieee! I don't want that `at all!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aiiiiiiieee! I don't want that [color=#e23b3b][i]at all![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, what Brendan meant to say was, there's no music yet because...
Spike steps forward to address the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! Everyone! Listen up!
The room goes quiet as everyone turns to listen!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I know you guys want to dance... Believe me, I want to dance too!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But we're just going to have to wait and kill time for a while because...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: HOWARD! HOWARD! WE'VE GOT AN EMERGENCY HERE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll... Just be right back...
Howard runs in to find Hector on his hands and knees by the sound system.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Somewhere around here... It's got to be somewhere around here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is it? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's the MusicBoxx! I can't find the MusicBoxx!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What do you mean, you can't find it? Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I knew where it was, would I be looking for it?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How could this happen? I never take it out of my pocket!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you talking about? You took it out five times at the mall to show off to hot girls! One of them turned out to be a dude with long hair!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Wait, which one?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, can't we just play the songs off your computer?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, well, the thing is... My computer is sort of fried... I got some kind of nasty virus that deleted my whole hard drive!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?! How did that happen? What web sites were you going to?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not my fault, man! The ad promised me a free MusicBoxx!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why would you even click that?! You already have a MusicBoxx!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, a second one would sure be handy right now, wouldn't it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, forget the hows and whys, okay? Right now, we've got to get to the mall and find the one I lost!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, what's going on here? You guys okay?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, do you need any help with the sound system?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! Well, sort of! I just need to go run a quick errand... You two can help by watching the party! We'll be right back!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you mean, watching the party?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, uh, I never signed on for this...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look. I know you guys pretty well. Between the two of you, you've definitely got the street smarts and the brainpower to run this thing!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry! Howard and I will be right back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's get moving!
Hector and Howard rush out.
Uh oh! Play as Spike and see if you can figure out how to keep the party under control!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are... Are we in charge of the party?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, put on some music! I want to dance!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Yeah! What kind of a lame dance party is this, anyway?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you want to break the news, or should I?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I think...

nodes.prompt: Do you want to break the news, or should I?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you want to break the news, or should I?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you said you had a school project to work on.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. My school project was to build a functional model of the solar system... Which I did in Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And just so you know, Howard... Jealousy is `not` a good look for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And just so you know, Howard... Jealousy is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a good look for you!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Aw, come on Linda, don't be hard on the guy! I'd be cranky too if I hadn't had the chance to see you all day!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, come on, now you're just being silly... Hee hee!
Howard squeezes the soda can so tight it explodes all over Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Geez, man, I wouldn't be `that` cranky!
nodes.text_bbcode: Geez, man, I wouldn't be [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] cranky!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, I've just spent all day setting up this party... I haven't had a chance to see you in a while!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw, that's sweet! I'll make sure we get some time together tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I thought you said you'd hang out with me...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now, come on, Kenji. You don't have to be possessive. You know I find that annoying.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, relax, man. I'm sure Linda's got plenty of time to hang out with both of us.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Big words from a guy who's doing his best impression of a soda crusher...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seriously, don't worry about it. Linda, do you want a tour of the house?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Absolutely!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why? What's the rush?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's that Kenji guy! She's been spending more and more time with him... And I know he's gonna make his move soon!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I don't ask her out tonight, I might not get another chance!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, all right, calm down. I'll play your stupid love song.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We still need to get a strobe light and some glow-in-the-dark paint... You ready for one last trip to the mall?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's do it!
One drive to the mall and several hours later... People start showing up for the party!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wow, Hector, way to go... This party is going to be great!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I love all the decorations!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: They're okay, I guess... But my 16th birthday party had `way` better lighting!
nodes.text_bbcode: They're okay, I guess... But my 16th birthday party had [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better lighting!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ah, lay off it, Paula. You're just mad because you didn't even get half this many people to turn up!

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now... Who wants to help me get the snacks ready?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I do!
Meanwhile, out in the backyard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You beat the final boss of 'Ultimate Renegade: Rogue Commando?'  I could never pull that off!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's all about finding the right balance between playing by your own rules and making sure that this time, it's personal!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hi, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hi, Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...And Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey there, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Linda said you wouldn't be able to make it tonight... Something about an Auto-Shop project...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh, I worked my butt off this afternoon to get it done. Linda and I did it together, actually... We had a blast!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I never knew welding could be so fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... Welding. Fun times. All those sparks... And tools... And sizzling romantic tension...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're, uh, clutching that soda pretty tight. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm fine... I just...

options.label: Didn't know you'd be with Kenji.
Hoped to spend some time with you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hmm, okay, I'll give you that. Linda `is` a total cutie.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm, okay, I'll give you that. Linda [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a total cutie.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Like, don't get me wrong... I would love to do some serious making out with her...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's, uh, a little too much information...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: In the hot tub out back... She's wearing a slinky red bikini... I'm wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? Huh? Sorry, man! I just got carried away!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What were we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was saying, it's urgent that I ask Linda out tonight!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, man, no! You `never` go for a girl based on her personality! Then they'll just let you down!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, man, no! You [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] go for a girl based on her personality! Then they'll just let you down!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Remember when I went out with Mona because she seemed so awesome, and then she turned out to be totally nuts?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dude, Mona was always totally nuts. In 7th grade, she made us all refer to her as 'Madame President' for a month!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well... My point still stands! It's like my dad always says... 'Playas don't prize personality, punk!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't your dad get divorced, like, four times?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Five, actually.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, it doesn't matter why I like her. The point is, I really need to ask Linda out tonight!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! You two! Cut it out!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Stay out of this, Spike!
Suddenly, Kim grabs Nicole and pulls her down! Nicole grabs onto Spike's shirt and takes him down with her!
The two girls resume fighting... With Spike caught in the middle!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Help! Brendan! Ow! Not the eyes! Not the eyes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm just gonna... Get going now...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just watch.
As Kim and Nicole keep fighting, more and more students gather around to watch!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Dude, this is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: What marvelous technique!
Eventually, nearly the whole party is outside!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now, everyone's distracted by the fight! Let's go inside, block off the bathrooms, pick up the stray clothes...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And find those stupid ferrets!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I thought you came here with Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah, I did... But you know how Kenji is at parties. He hangs out for ten minutes and then disappears with his Auto-Shop buddies!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just hope Hector gets back soon... This party is getting really out of hand! I don't know half these people!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sure someone has it under control...
And in the den...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is totally out of hand! I don't even know half these people!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Word must've gotten out that there was a party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, this is insane! I just saw a bunch of girls in bikinis hanging out in a bathtub!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Dude, that's not even the craziest! Have you seen the backyard? Between the belly dancing and the fire juggling, I'm amazed this house is still standing!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Um, excuse me, are you two in charge of the party?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sort of?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, I was wondering if either of you had seen a pair of ferrets running around.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ferrets?! Why the heck did you bring a pair of ferrets to a party?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Odin and Cyclops are usually very well-behaved...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eeeeeek! There's a giant, one-eyed rat in the salsa!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Noooooooo! Odin!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is a disaster!
Suddenly, there's a loud scream from outside!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What now?
Brendan and Spike rush outside and find Nicole and Kim screaming at each other!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You tried to steal my boyfriend! It's your fault $Josh moved out of town!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, hello? You're the one who `cheated on him!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hello? You're the one who [color=#3b78e2][i]cheated on him![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I only cheated on him because he was spending all his time with you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Aaaaaargggh!
Nicole tackles Kim to the ground! The two of them start furiously wrestling!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dude! What do we do?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I say we...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm doing it, and you can't stop me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, come on!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy... You told me to be strong and independent!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I didn't mean with me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's see here...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Hector and I had to run an errand. We'll be there soon. Wish I was with you now!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Add a little smiley face... And we're good!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Blech! Bleeeeeeccch!
Back at the party...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ooo, a text!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aw, it's from Howard! He says he wishes he were here with me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Howard is the sweetest guy. You know when we were in Europe, he just spent the whole time wishing you were there, right?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aww... Well, I really wish he were here now. I was really hoping to spend some time with him tonight!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe you're right! Maybe I ought to play hard to get!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heck yeah, man! That's what I'm talking about!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. I won't text her, and she'll have to come `to me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All right. I won't text her, and she'll have to come [color=#e23b3b][i]to me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly!
Meanwhile, at the party...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: He still hasn't texted me back! I hope he's okay...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm sure he's fine... He's probably just busy helping Hector out. Howard's a pretty dedicated friend...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're... You're probably right. I just hope he gets back soon... I was really hoping to spend some time with him tonight!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh, all right... Go get the number.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hee hee!
And so, a few minutes later...
Ring...
Ring...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Hello? Who is this?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: 'Allo, Principle Shapiro? Zis is Jean-Claude Francois, zee sexy French guitarist!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I 'ave seen your ad on zee website 'NaughtyPrincipal.com' and I would like to have a, how you say, good party time with you?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Oh my! Why, Mr. Francois, I only put that ad up yesterday! I wasn't expecting anyone to reply so quickly!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I, uh, oh my, I would love to meet up with you! Are you available this Friday?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Yes? I am... Zat is... Not me... I... Uh... By which I mean... Uh...
Spike frantically hangs up the phone!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well? What'd she say?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm not 100% sure... But I think I have a date with Shapiro!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Way to go, stud!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hee hee! This party is awesome!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Brendan... Are you sure that's, uh, the best idea...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, right! Things are seriously awkward between Spike and Kim! I totally forgot!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, a dare's a dare, right? And we've got to stick to the rules...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Without them, the game just turns into people telling secrets and taking off clothes, with no rhyme or reason!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Sounds like my cousin's wedding...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, okay... I guess rules are rules...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right, Spike, remember your fighting strategy... Punch him in the face and kick him in the shins! It's unbeatable!

nodes.text: What should I do first, loser... Punch you in the face or kick you in the shins?!

And nails Spike right in the gut!

nodes.text: I don't know if that's healthy...

Alexei flexes, revealing massive biceps!

nodes.text: Just try and fight me, nerd! Try it! I dare you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, whatever... Can we just have the MusicBoxx back?

nodes.text: Ahem, sorry... Before I punch your face in `diplomatically.`

nodes.text: Bring it!

nodes.text: HEY!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.text: There's no need to fight! Zach... We'll make a deal!

nodes.text: I oughta beat the crap outta him!

nodes.text: You're right! I'll get that MusicBoxx back... Or die trying!

nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't matter. What does matter is the MusicBoxx you two little demons stole from Zach!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What... What MusicBoxx?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't play innocent! I know all about your little lemonade stand pickpocketing racket!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Which, by the way, is `not okay!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Which, by the way, is [color=#e23b3b][i]not okay![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But we'll deal with that later! Right now, I just want that MusicBoxx back!
Kay and Kel confer with each other for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: All right, all right, you big jerk. Here you go.
Kay hands Howard the MusicBoxx!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you! You have no idea what I went through tonight to get this!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Why do you care so much about it, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's Hector's MusicBoxx... And it was really important that I got it for him!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Tell him he's got a great playlist!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We liked the songs with all the swearing!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We didn't like that one stupid 80s love song though... So we deleted it and put on a song by Rhianna Louisiana!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You did what?! Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: She's a really good singer!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: She knows what it's like to be a tween!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you have any idea what you've done?!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: What was that noise? What's going on in there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got to get out of here... But I'll deal with you two later!
Howard dives out the window and runs off!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hee hee! Howard is so silly!
A few minutes later... Hector and Howard are driving back to the party.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen man, it's just a love song. Why can't you just ask her out without it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I just asked Linda out, then... Then I'd be treating her like any other girl.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But she's not like any girl. She's special. She's the most amazing girl I've ever met... And she deserves the best boyfriend out there.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted to give her something special, something grand, something really romantic... Something that showed just how much I care...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, if you really care about this girl... If she really means that much to you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then just tell her that. I'm sure she'll understand, man! She's gotta!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heck yeah! All we gotta do is get back to the party... Everything's gonna be fine!
And at Zach's house...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If it isn't Bonnie and Clyde.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why do people keep saying that?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I dunno, it's what that cop at the mall said when I came in... I thought it sounded pretty tough!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Now, how about telling me what the heck you're doing here?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How about `you` give me back the MusicBoxx you stole before I punch your face in?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How about [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] give me back the MusicBoxx you stole before I punch your face in?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem, sorry... Before I punch your face in `diplomatically.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem, sorry... Before I punch your face in [color=#e23b3b][i]diplomatically.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So that was `your` MusicBoxx, huh? I just grabbed it from the Lost and Found because it looked nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: So that was [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] MusicBoxx, huh? I just grabbed it from the Lost and Found because it looked nice!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I guess I should've figured it was yours, though... The party playlist was terrible!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That does it, son. You're about to find out why they call me 'Hector the Dissector'!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Bring it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: HEY!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's no need to fight! Zach... We'll make a deal!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what could you possibly offer me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If you'll just give us back the MusicBoxx, Hector will...

What do you mean, you promised them a live band?!
Hey, man, you're the one that put us in this position!
You should just be happy this place is still standing! Do you have any idea what we had to deal with?
I'm sorry... You're right. But what the heck are we supposed to do now?
I went through all that effort to get the MusicBoxx... But now, that'll just seem like a copout!
Wait a minute... Wait a minute...
I have a brilliant idea!
Fifteen minutes later, the four guys are gathered on the back deck... And they're all holding musical instruments!
Spike has his harmonica... Brendan's got a keyboard... Hector's on guitar... And Howard's holding a microphone!
I can't believe I let you talk me into this...
Yeah, yeah... I'll owe you big time!
Howard taps the mic and turns to the crowd.
Attention, everyone! Are you ready to rock?
Crowd
Woo hoo!
We might look like four confused guys with no idea what they're doing... But tonight, we're rock sensation `Four Confused Guys!`
And before we begin... I'd like to dedicate this song to one very special girl... A girl who'd I go to the ends of the earth for... A girl like none other...
Linda, this one's for you!
Brendan starts playing the first few notes of 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady'! Hector and Spike join in!
All right, it's all up to me now... Let's just hope I remember the lyrics!
{ And girl, I wanna kiss your trees so bad... {

Booooo! Booooo!
The other three guys abruptly stop playing.
What's wrong, guys? What's the deal?
Dude, I don't know what you think you're singing... But it sure isn't 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady'!
I `knew` it wasn't about linear algebra!
I guess I just panicked...
Howard turns around to face the crowd, but everyone has already scattered.
Linda? Are you out there?
Uh, I got some bad news for you, bro... While you were embarrassing yourself, she left with Kenji!
But... But...
You didn't see that? He totally had his arm around her waist...
Yeah, and it looked kind of like he was kissing her ear!
But I... I came so close...
Think of it this way... Maybe it's not the destination that matters... But the journey!
No, all I really cared about was the destination.
Well, then, you're sort of out of luck.
Ouch, that's got to sting... Coming so close and falling apart at the last second!
We know Howard's got it in him to be a singing sensation... So try one more time and win Linda's heart!

A few minutes later...
Why are there cops all around my house?
I don't know... Hey, is your roof on fire?
So this is `your` house, huh?
Why am I not surprised?
What's going on here, Officer?
What's going on? What's going on? I'll tell you what's going on!
Noise disturbances! Unsupervised minors! Unlicensed boxing! Illegal gambling! Unlawful possession of domesticated rodents!
Repeat that last one?
What we've got here, boys, is the biggest madhouse this side of Minneapolis!
What happened to Brendan and Spike? We left those guys in charge!
Oh, are you referring to Bonnie and Clyde over there? They tried to convince me they had the situation under control...
Monte nudges his head towards a cop car. Brendan and Spike sit sadly in the backseat.
They're gonna learn how to keep things under control where they're going!
Prison. They're going to prison.
I got that, yeah.
You boys are just lucky those outstanding lads from Wilson High were here to keep things under control!
Hector and Brendan look over to the side, where Alexei is grinning and chatting with a few of the cops.
That's my nephew... Good looking kid, eh? He's already promised to testify at your trials... You better hope he's got nice things to say!
Now hop in the back of that cop car... You two have a long night ahead of you!
Arrested, unloved, and shamed by Wilson? That's no way to end a game!
Try again, and see what happens when you're able to keep the party under control!

The crowd bursts into thunderous applause!
Way to go!
One more time!
Woooo!
That was amazing!
We did it!
Heck yeah!
Thanks for helping me out, guys... Now, if you'll excuse me, I've got a girl to find!
Howard runs through the crowd, and finds Linda waiting at the far side of the yard.
Howard... What you said up there... Did you mean it?
Linda, I've liked you from the moment I met you. You're fun, you're charming, and you are so beautiful I can't even find the words to describe you.
If you like Kenji, then that's fine, I understand, but I just need you to know that I...
Howard...
Linda leans forward and kisses Howard!
Howard, what you did tonight... Setting this all up... It's the sweetest, most romantic thing any guy has ever done for me.
Then we... That is to say... You will... Are we...
Dating? Yes, silly. Of course!
And Kenji...?
Kenji's a really cool guy and a great friend, but... I don't think he's really the boyfriend type, you know?
Howard glances across the party, where Kenji is standing and watching the two of them.
For one moment, he looks heartbroken... Then he shakes his head and walks away.
Hey party people! Are you ready to party?!
You want to go dance?
With you? Absolutely!
Meanwhile, down the street...
Linda...
Hey! Where are you going? The party's just getting good!
Look, I... I just kind of want to go home, okay? I don't really feel like partying.
Huh? Since when?
Wait a minute... Are you... Upset? Is this about that Linda girl?!
...No. She's, uh, just a fling. I don't care about her.
Liar! I can't believe it but... You're actually moping about a girl!
Oh, like you're some big romantic expert? Just leave me alone, Megan.
Huh! Kenji pining away for some girl... I never thought I'd see this day! I guess anything really is possible!
And there you have it! Howard and Linda, together at last... And all thanks to you!
As for Kenji, well... Let's just say he's not the kind of guy to give up easily!
We hope you enjoyed this episode of 'Surviving High School' as much as we did! See you next week, party animal!
You know how to party, and you know how to sing... But you don't quite know how to play a perfect game.
Play one more time... That bonus scene is just within reach!
Well, you did a great job, but it doesn't quite cut it... Ah, who are we kidding?
You played a perfect game, and you know it! So enjoy your bonus scene, and find out what happens on the morning after!
Ugggghhh... What a party! I'm totally exhausted!
My legs are sore from dancing so much...
Hey, has anyone seen my hat? I took it off when we all got in the bathtub...
Let me tell you... You kids are wimps! You call that a party?
Back in my day, it wasn't a party unless someone was bleeding from the head, and someone else was pointing and laughing at them!
What are you doing here?!
No, wait... I don't want to know!
Oh man, that was insane... What a crazy night!
I partied so late, I can barely remember anything... But I'm pretty sure I made out with someone!
Mmmm, hi there, Zach...
Wait a minute... You're not Zach!
Oh no...
It happened again!

nodes.text: It's a quiet Saturday afternoon at Hector's house, where he and Howard are busy setting up snacks... And planning one very loud evening!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey man, I can't thank you enough for helping me set up for this party... I don't know how I would've done it without you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I'm more pumped than you are! I can't believe your dad let you have the house to yourself for a whole weekend!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heck, I had to lie and tell my parents that I was going to an `Academic Achievers` sleepover just so I could come here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heck, I had to lie and tell my parents that I was going to an [color=#e23b3b][i]Academic Achievers[/i][/color] sleepover just so I could come here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, my dad doesn't usually trust me either... But there was no way he was gonna miss the State Shuffleboard Finals!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'You can have some friends over if you want,' he told me... 'Just `don't` throw some huge party!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'You can have some friends over if you want,' he told me... 'Just [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] throw some huge party!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't you invite half the school? Won't he be mad?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Howard, old buddy, how can he be mad over something he'll never know about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Touche!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now let's see... We've got snacks... We've got the plasma screen set up with the WeeBox 360... We've got tons of drinks...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And we've got my dad's state-of-the-art sound system rigged up and ready to go! Look at this thing, man! These speakers will rock the entire neighborhood!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You've got your playlist ready?
Hector reaches into his pocket and takes out a sleek, black MusicBoxx.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I got it all right here, baby. The Ultimate Party Playlist!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The smooth hip-hop stylings of `Tiny William`... The bumping dance beats of `The Assassins`... The head-banging fury of `Be Angry With The Institution`...
nodes.text_bbcode: The smooth hip-hop stylings of [color=#e23b3b][i]Tiny William[/i][/color]... The bumping dance beats of [color=#e23b3b][i]The Assassins[/i][/color]... The head-banging fury of [color=#e23b3b][i]Be Angry With The Institution[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Trust me, Howard. The minute I put this mix on, this place is going to get so freaky, it'll be a health hazard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know if that's the best choice of imagery... But listen, did you get the song I requested?
Hector narrows his eyes at Howard.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. I got it. And it wasn't easy to find. The 1984 Las Vegas Live recording of 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady' by `Smoothanasia`, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. I got it. And it wasn't easy to find. The 1984 Las Vegas Live recording of 'Girl, Will You Be My Lady' by [color=#e23b3b][i]Smoothanasia[/i][/color], right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's the one! That was their best performance ever!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Why do you want to listen to some cheesy eighties love song?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, the thing is... It's kind of Linda's favorite love song...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aw, man, I knew it! You have seriously got to be the cheesiest dude on the planet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Tell me you weren't planning to do some big lame thing when the song plays!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually... I was kind of thinking of asking her out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no, man. No no no. Why would a strapping young guy like you want to get tangled up in a relationship?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I dunno, Hector... I really like her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's so great about her, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well...
